review_candidates.description: Career Opportunities: Country Director Sudan (14697) Requisition ID 14697 - Posted 10/06/2026 - Khartoum - Full Time  Job Description Print Preview Are you looking for a meaningful job where you can invest your skills, passion, and time in an impactful way? Do you want to work for an organization that is dynamic, goal-driven, and dedicated to making a difference? Welcome to Welthungerhilfe! Welthungerhilfe (WHH) is one of Germany’s largest private aid organizations. Politically and religiously independent, we work toward a world without hunger. Together with national and international partners, we respond to humanitarian crises and support long-term solutions that improve the living conditions for the most vulnerable people. We change and shape food systems, we are locally-led and globally connected. As an impact-oriented and human-centered organization, we use innovation, evidence and data-informed decision-making to continuously improve our work and contribute to #Zero Hunger. Our vision: "Zero Hunger on a Healthy Planet." Join us in creating a world where everyone has access to food while ensuring a sustainable future for our planet. If you are ready to make an impact, we look forward to receiving your application! Country Director Sudan* in Khartoum The position is to be filled as soon as possible, with an initial contract duration of one year. There are very good prospects for an extension. Employment location will be Khartoum, Sudan should security situation allow. Otherwise the Country office is based on Port Sudan. Welthungerhilfe (WHH) is present in Sudan since 1982, and is currently implementing projects in North Darfur, Kassala, Gedaref, River Nile and Red Sea States. In line with our global mandate to Fight Hunger, WHH focuses in Sudan on Humanitarian Assistance and WASH as well as on strengthening climate resilient agriculture, natural resource management and economic development of rural communities and IDPs. As Country Director Sudan, you will lead an impact-oriented country programme spanning humanitarian assistance and long-term development. You will ensure alignment with WHH's global strategy, quality standards, Code of Conduct, organizational values, and partnership principles. You will represent WHH in relevant humanitarian and development forums, strengthen strategic partnerships, lead resource mobilization and donor engagement, and secure new funding opportunities. In Sudan's highly complex operating environment, you will provide strategic leadership across programme quality, organizational performance, security, people management, and operational effectiveness. As part of the WHH Global Leadership Team you will contribute to organizational leadership and continuous improvement of our work globally, regionally and within Sudan. Your responsibilities Provide strategic leadership and overall management of WHH’s country programme in a complex and evolving context. Lead high-quality humanitarian and development programming, driving innovation and the implementation of WHH’s Food Systems Approach. Ensure the financial sustainability of the country programme through effective and efficient resource management, financial stewardship and resource mobilization. Continue to diversify the funding basis of the country program, including new, innovative institutional and private donors willing to support with longer term funding. Lead and manage a diverse team in a complex, challenging context, giving special attention to (national) staff development. Lead and develop a high-performing Senior Management Team, fostering a culture of accountability, learning, innovation and adherence to WHH’s values and Code of Conduct. Ensure effective risk management, safeguarding, security, duty of care and business continuity. Forge and maintain strong relationships with other international and national organizations and continue to expand outreach through relevant meetings, workshops, and conferences. Team: Join our dedicated and diverse teams, where passion, expertise, and joy come together to create a better world. review_candidates.title: Core Lead
review_candidates.description: As our Core Lead, you'll be the technical owner of HBF's core insurance platforms, E5, InRule and Ensure, taking accountability for their technical health, stability, performance, resilience and control environment. Sitting within Core Platforms, this is a hands-on senior technical leadership role where you'll work alongside Product Owners and specialists across Technology to keep our critical platforms running reliably while continuously improving how they operate. You'll lead technical lifecycle management, incident and problem management, observability, resilience, platform controls and change and release governance. You'll also lead and develop a small team, mentor technical capability across the tribe and work closely with vendors and teams across Infrastructure, Cyber Security, Technology Risk and Governance, Data and Analytics and Enterprise Architecture. What you'll do Take technical ownership of E5, InRule and Ensure, driving platform stability, performance, resilience and lifecycle management Lead platform upgrades, technical debt reduction and continuous improvement Own the operational health of batch processing, scheduling, platform interfaces and file transfers Strengthen monitoring and observability using tools such as Dynatrace and Splunk Lead technical response to major platform incidents and drive problem management, root cause analysis and permanent fixes Own technical assessments for changes and releases and ensure appropriate technical, stability and non-functional requirements are considered Strengthen operational resilience, business continuity and disaster recovery readiness Manage technical controls, vulnerabilities, access and remediation activity in line with HBF's risk and compliance obligations Lead, mentor and grow technical capability across Core Platforms while championing automation, maintainability and better engineering practices. About you You're an experienced technical leader who enjoys taking genuine ownership of complex platforms and making them safer, more reliable and easier to operate. You're comfortable getting into the technical detail when it matters, but you can also step back, assess risk and communicate a clear position to non-technical stakeholders. When something goes wrong, you bring structure and sound judgement, when things are running well, you're already thinking about how to make them better. You'll bring a strong understanding of enterprise platform operations in a regulated environment, coupled with the ability to influence teams, work effectively with vendors and develop technical capability in others. We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives are valued and celebrated, because they make us stronger. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disabilities and members of the LGBTQIA+ community. We want you to Be You, Be Bold, and feel supported every step of the way. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact us at careers@hbf.com.au so we can work together to accommodate your needs. As the senior technical authority for the Cloud Platforms Team, you will help shape the overarching technical vision and multi-cloud roadmap across AWS, Azure and GCP to accelerate real-world scientific discovery. If you want your technical leadership to directly empower the research solving Australia’s greatest challenges, this is your platform to make a lasting impact. High-level duties include: Provide leadership and direction to the Cloud Platforms team, ensuring high-quality delivery of CSIRO’s enterprise and research cloud services across AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform. Manage the technical aspects of CSIRO’s cloud platform capability, including responsibility for technical roadmaps, service maturity uplift, automation adoption, and alignment with CSIRO’s strategic technology direction. Allocate and coordinate cloud engineering resources to support operational stability, project delivery, and capability uplift across research and enterprise platforms. Drive adoption of cloud-native patterns, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD pipelines, containerisation, and automated operational processes to improve reliability, scalability and efficiency. Lead cloud security uplift in line with Australian Government ISM controls, working with the Cyber Security team to maintain continuous compliance, robust identity models, and appropriate risk management. Oversee cloud cost optimisation activities including FinOps practices, tagging standards, spend forecasting, reserved instance planning, and workload rightsizing. Deep technical expertise across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, including architecture, security controls, automation, and operational best practice. Strong understanding of cloud-native technologies (IaC, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, observability stacks, API-driven automation). Proven ability to set strategic direction, lead complex technical programs, and deliver large scale platform capability uplift. Strong experience in cloud security, governance frameworks, identity management, and compliance obligations (including ISM). Demonstrated experience with cloud financial optimisation and cost governance models. Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication, and vendor management skills. Desirable Cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Architect Expert, GCP Professional Cloud Architect). Experience enabling cloud support for research workloads, data-intensive science, or HPC through-cloud. Understanding of FinOps practices and cloud budgeting cycles in large organisations. Experience working within government, research, or regulated environments. For full details about this role, and other criteria, please review the Position Description. Not sure if you meet all the criteria? While it is CSIRO policy that the successful candidate must meet all the essential criteria, there are many ways to demonstrate this. Don’t let the list discourage you. If you are unsure about applying, please reach out to the contact person in the Position Description. As an equal employment opportunity organisation, we are committed to creating diverse and inclusive teams where people feel they belong. We recognise true diversity encompasses all ages, abilities, cultures, faiths, levels of education, genders, sexualities, diversity of thought and much more. We focus on hiring people who share our values of People First, Further Together, Making it Real and Trusted. CSIRO holds Platinum Status for the Australian Workplace Equality Index for LGBTQIA+ inclusion, and a Science in Australia Gender Equity Bronze Award. review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 职位核心： 全面负责公司产品在各大客户渠道（NKA、会员KA、CVS、新零售、潮玩渠道）的战略规划、生意拓展和团队管理，确保销售目标、市场份额及利润指标的达成。 一、战略规划与生意增长 制定渠道战略： 根据公司整体业务目标，制定年度、季度大客户渠道生意计划，为不同渠道（NKA/会员KA/CVS/新零售/潮玩）设定差异化的销售目标、产品组合、价格及促销策略。 驱动业务增长： 负责达成全渠道的销售、利润、分销、陈列等关键绩效指标（KPI），并持续挖掘各渠道潜力，寻找新的生意增长点。 P&L管理： 负责大客户渠道的损益管理，合理规划并控制渠道费用预算（包括贸易条款、促销费用、市场费用等），提升渠道盈利能力。 市场洞察： 深入研究各渠道发展趋势、消费者行为及竞争对手动态，为公司的产品开发、市场策略提供决策依据。 二、客户关系与合作伙伴管理 战略客户管理： 直接主导或指导团队与NKA、会员KA等核心客户的全国/区域总部建立并维护高层战略合作伙伴关系。 关键谈判： 主导与重点客户的年度合同谈判，包括进场条件、价格体系、促销资源、付款方式等，最大化保障公司利益。 联合生意计划（JBP）： 与战略客户制定并落实联合生意计划，实现资源整合与生意共赢。 三、跨渠道精细化运营 NKA/会员KA渠道： 聚焦传统大卖场的份额稳定，并深耕会员制KA的独特模式，打造差异化产品组合，驱动会员购买频次与客单价。 CVS渠道： 针对便利店系统的高频、即时性消费特点，优化产品SKU，抢占早餐、零食等消费场景，提升单店产出的同时推进数字化营销。 新零售渠道： 制定并领导社团/社群/O2O平台（如叮咚、美团）/电商平台（如拼多多） 的运营策略，管理线上价格体系，策划引流爆款活动，实现线上线下一体化运营。 潮玩渠道： 把握年轻消费趋势，与名创优品、KKV等客户合作开发渠道专供产品或定制化包装，打造爆款，管理终端视觉陈列，提升品牌时尚感。 四、团队领导与组织建设 团队管理： 负责大客户团队的组建、培训、激励与绩效考核，打造高绩效、高协作的销售队伍。 目标分解与过程管理： 将总体目标科学分解至各渠道及团队成员，通过定期会议、报表系统追踪进度，确保执行到位。 人才发展： 培养下属的专业能力，搭建人才梯队，为团队发展提供持续动力。 五、跨部门协同 与市场部协同： 确保品牌市场活动在各渠道的有效落地，并反馈渠道声音，助力新品开发与推广。 与供应链协同： 与供应链、物流部门紧密合作，确保对各渠道（尤其是订单波动大的新零售渠道）的快速响应与高效履约，优化库存水平。 大客户渠道部经理任职要求 一、学历与经验 学历： 大学本科及以上学历，市场营销、企业管理等相关专业优先。 经验： 8年以上快速消费品行业销售经验，其中至少5年大客户管理或渠道管理经验，3年以上团队管理经验。 行业背景： 必须具有食品/饮品行业背景，熟悉食品行业特性（如保质期、周转率、口味趋势等）。 渠道经验： 必须具备您所列出的多重渠道管理经验，深刻理解： NKA系统的运作规则和谈判流程。 会员制KA的选品逻辑和会员运营模式。 CVS系统的运营特点和配送要求。 新零售渠道的数字化工具和流量玩法。 潮玩渠道的产品创新和营销模式。 二、核心能力与技能 战略思维与商业洞察力： 能够制定宏观渠道战略，并对生意的盈亏结果有敏锐的分析和掌控能力。 优秀的谈判与沟通影响力： 具备与各层级客户沟通的能力，尤其是与大型零售商高层建立互信、达成战略共识的能力。 领导力与团队发展能力： 能够激励和带领跨渠道团队，凝聚团队力量完成挑战性目标。 数据分析能力： 熟练使用Office软件及数据分析工具，善于从销售数据中发现问题、发现机会，并驱动决策。 解决复杂问题的能力： 能够妥善处理多渠道间的冲突（如价格冲突、资源竞争），找到平衡与解决方案。 极强的抗压性与适应性： 能够适应快消品行业的高速变化和业绩压力。

review_candidates.title: Video Editor
review_candidates.description: Company Description EO is a global media company headquartered in San Francisco, USA.  Our mission: build Silicon Valley everywhere. EO Vietnam empowers the next generation of builders through original content on our local channels, while also serving as EO's production hub in Ho Chi Minh City for EO Global and EO's global network. From founder documentaries to product launches and fundraising announcements, our team creates stories that reach audiences in Vietnam and around the world. Job Summary EO Việt Nam is looking for a full-time Video Editor to join our creative team. You’ll be responsible for turning raw footage into impactful videos for our YouTube channel and other platforms. This includes editing interviews, podcast series, and news videos. If you have a strong sense of storytelling, attention to detail, and a passion for meaningful content, we’d love to work with you. English comprehension is required. Key Responsibilities Edit videos for EO Global’s YouTube channel, including interviews and podcast-style content. Transform long-form content into engaging short-form videos for social media platforms (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok, etc.). Enhance storytelling through pacing, structure, motion graphics, dynamic typography, sound design, and visual elements. Collaborate closely with the Content Producer and Host to ensure the message is clearly and emotionally delivered through editing choices. Support video production when needed, including basic filming setup, camera operation, and ensuring footage quality during shoots. Manage post-production workflow, including organizing project files, footage, assets, and maintaining an efficient editing system. Source and integrate supporting materials (stock footage, images, music, sound effects, etc.) to enhance video quality. Ensure final video quality through color grading, audio balancing, subtitles, and platform-specific optimization. Participate in creative brainstorming sessions to develop new content ideas and improve storytelling and video performance. Qualifications At least 1+ year of professional experience in in Video Editing and Video Production, with experience working across different formats, aspect ratios, and platforms. Experience with interviews, documentaries, vlogs, or YouTube content is a big plus. Proficiency in Final Cut Pro and/or Adobe Premiere Pro. Knowledge of After Effects or motion design tools is a strong advantage. Strong understanding of color grading and visual consistency to enhance storytelling and maintain professional video quality. Good sense of visual storytelling, pacing, rhythm, typography, and emotional impact. Understanding of social media video formats and best practices across platforms such as YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram. Strong attention to detail, ability to receive and apply feedback, and willingness to collaborate with creative teams. Effective time management skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects under deadlines. Adaptability, eagerness to learn, and comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment. Comfortable communicating in English and Vietnamese is beneficial. Preferred if you Have experience editing storytelling-based or cinematic-style videos. Have experience shooting videos or operating cameras for interviews, documentaries, vlogs, or social media content. Understand how YouTube works (thumbnails, retention, pacing...). Working conditions This is a full-time position based in District 2, Ho Chi Minh City Employees can work remotely up to 2 days per week, with flexibility depending on project requirements and team collaboration needs.
